title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Falls 0.9% to $143.89 (Oct 29)
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) fell 0.92% to $143.89 on Oct 29 as a tech selloff led by Alphabet hit the Nasdaq, while a report named Anthropic as its top customer.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Fell


None of the coverage reviewed for this article named a company-specific reason for Thursday's decline, and SPCX moved with the tech selloff. According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-october-29-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-alphabet-microsoft-earnings-130305714.html) ,[Alphabet's third-quarter results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/alphabet-q3-earnings-miss-sinks-stock-reignites-ai-capex-fears-googl-nasdaq-futures/) set off a sell-off in its shares and brought worries about AI spending back to the market, as investors focused on its free cash flow and the return on its AI investment. Software and chip stocks also fell, while investors rotated toward defensive sectors such as healthcare, financials and real estate.


Company news centered on SpaceX's biggest customer. According to SpaceX's[quarterly report on Form 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm) , filed with the SEC on October 22, one unnamed client labeled Customer B accounted for 34.5% of consolidated revenue in the three months ended September 30, all of it in the Super Intelligence (SI) segment.


On Thursday, Bloomberg News reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that Customer B is Anthropic, which would make it SpaceX's largest customer ahead of the US government, as reported by[Investing.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/anthropic-accounts-over-third-spacex-014451805.html) . Per[The Next Web](https://thenextweb.com/news/anthropic-spacex-largest-customer-customer-b) , Anthropic declined to comment and SpaceX did not respond to Bloomberg.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Revenue growth: per the 10-Q, total revenue reached $14,575 million in the third quarter, up from $5,576 million a year earlier, with SI revenue at $7,560 million against $813 million and Connectivity revenue at $5,248 million against $3,097 million.
- Profit turnaround: the same filing shows income from operations of $2,791 million against an operating loss of $273 million a year earlier, and net income of $4,404 million against a net loss of $1,054 million.
- Contracted demand: according to Investing.com, Anthropic's IPO disclosures show it agreed to spend up to $120.5 billion on computing contracts with SpaceX through 2029, roughly $3.1 billion a month starting in December.


### Risks


- Customer concentration: Customer B made up 34.5% of quarterly revenue, and one customer represented 27.7% of net accounts receivable as of September 30, per the 10-Q.
- Exit terms: Investing.com reported that the contracts let Anthropic terminate with 90 days' notice beginning in early 2027.
- Heavy spending: purchases of property, plant and equipment reached $48,069 million in the first nine months of 2026, up from $13,846 million a year earlier, at a time when, per Yahoo Finance, worries about AI spending returned to the market.
